fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Mark the primary access drive entry clearly so responders can distinguish it from other vehicle parking areas on approach.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear sightlines and overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Clear a designated turnaround area and keep it free of parked vehicles so emergency vehicles can reverse direction without blocking the drive.
• Keep at least one parking area clear of vehicles at all times to allow emergency vehicle staging.
• Cut back dense vegetation bordering the walkway to allow responders to move quickly between the access drive and the residence.
• Post visible signage or markings identifying which access point leads directly to the main residence entrance.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that extend close to or over any part of the house or attached structures.
• Thin trees within the scattered clusters nearest to the house to create gaps between individual tree canopies.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the house.
• Thin scattered shrubs near the house so they are separated from each other and from the structure.
• Keep the area directly around the house clear of dead leaves, loose bark, and dry plant debris.
• Maintain the open green space by keeping grass mowed short, especially where it connects to shrubs or trees near the house.
• Keep branches along all driveway access routes trimmed high enough to allow emergency vehicles to pass through without obstruction.
• Remove any dead branches from trees near the house before they fall and collect on the ground.
